blocks.text: 1H NMR spectrum do marahil mein samjha jata hai. Low-resolution spectrum (30.4.1) proton environments ki tadaad, un ki qismein aur protons ki nisbati tadaad deta hai; high-resolution spectrum (30.4.2) yeh bhi dikhata hai ke har peak parosi protons se kaise bat'ti hai. O-H aur N-H protons khaas test (30.4.3) se pehchane jate hain.

blocks.prompt: 1H NMR spectrum ki kaun si qism parosi protons se peaks ka batna dikhati hai?

items: Low resolution: protons ki tadaad, qism aur nisbati tadaad; high resolution batna bhi.
